facts.fact: The Government Data and Cloud Computing Center was inaugurated by President Sisi on 28 April 2024 and built by the state with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology; the president said it cost billions of dollars.
facts.system: Government Data and Cloud Computing Center

facts.fact: The report says services of the Government Data and Cloud Computing Center are used by 50,000 public employees and that ministries, which each ran their own servers, are to be served by it.
